title: Köppen-Geiger is a classification, not a cause
summary: Peel, Finlayson, and McMahon published "Updated world map of the Köppen-Geiger climate classification" in Hydrology and Earth System Sciences in 2007. The Köppen-Geiger system sort
body: Peel, Finlayson, and McMahon published "Updated world map of the Köppen-Geiger climate classification" in Hydrology and Earth System Sciences in 2007. The Köppen-Geiger system sorts climates by temperature and precipitation patterns and by the vegetation those patterns support. The 2007 paper updates the world map with a stated data set and method. A class on that map is a description of a climate's statistics, not an explanation of why the climate is that way. Boundaries move if the underlying observations or the thresholds change. Using a Köppen label as if it were a natural kind with sharp edges overstates a useful classification. The paper is the place to see which data and which rules produced that particular map.
